body.statement: Every finite sharp endpoint in \(\{L(q;\delta_D,\delta_S),U(q;\delta_D,\delta_S)\}\) is attained by a compatible full response law whose legal observational-arc representation has at most \(m\{4(K+1)-1\}+2\) positive arcs. Such a law can be extracted from a reduced optimum by exposing the endpoint face, maximizing \(H\) on that face, and selecting a vertex.
body.justification: Sharpness is empirically auditable only when endpoint allocations can be reported as finite latent-law certificates.
body.gap: Generic bound solvers certify an objective value but need not return a sparse, positive-denominator full-law lift for the selected principal stratum.
body.consumer: Endpoint certificates let analysts diagnose which compliance, selection, and outcome types drive robustness conclusions in Job Corps and Oregon.
